name: gopeed-extension-gdrive
author: Ahmed-Alsaigh
title: Google Drive Resolver
description: Resolves Google Drive file and folder links using Google Apps Script or Google Drive API v3.

settings.name: scriptUrl
settings.title: Option A: Apps Script Web App URL
settings.description: Paste your deployed Google Apps Script Web App URL (https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec). Leave blank if using an API Key.

settings.name: apiKey
settings.title: Option B: Google Drive API v3 Key
settings.description: Paste your Google Cloud Console API Key (AIzaSy...). Used if Apps Script URL is blank.

settings.name: recursive
settings.title: Resolve Subfolders Recursively
settings.description: Automatically traverse nested subfolders when resolving a Drive folder.
